title: Diet Planner - Agents, MCP & LLM
description: Orchestrator, A2A sub-agents and MCP server: requests, latency, LLM usage, tools, traces and logs.

panels.title: Plans requested
panels.description: Requests to the orchestrator's /run and /run_sse endpoints in the selected range.

targets.expr: sum (((last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="diet-orchestrator", http_route=~"/run.*"}[$__range]) - http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="diet-orchestrator", http_route=~"/run.*"} offset $__range) >= 0) or last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name="diet-orchestrator", http_route=~"/run.*"}[$__range]))

panels.title: p95 end-to-end latency
panels.description: 95% of plan requests finished faster than this.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (((last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="diet-orchestrator", http_route=~"/run.*"}[$__range]) - http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="diet-orchestrator", http_route=~"/run.*"} offset $__range) >= 0) or last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="diet-orchestrator", http_route=~"/run.*"}[$__range])))

panels.title: HTTP 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of HTTP requests that failed with a server error, across the selected services.

targets.expr: (sum(((last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range]) - http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_response_status_code=~"5.."} offset $__range) >= 0) or last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service", http_response_status_code=~"5.."}[$__range])) or vector(0)) / sum(((last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]) - http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service"} offset $__range) >= 0) or last_over_time(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_name=~"$service"}[$__range]))

panels.title: LLM calls
panels.description: Gemini generate_content calls across all agents.

panels.title: Tokens used
panels.description: Gemini input + output tokens across all agents.

panels.title: Agent invocation duration (p95)
panels.description: ADK invoke_agent duration per agent. The sub-agents appear twice: as seen by the orchestrator and by themselves.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_agent_name, service_name) (((gen_ai_invoke_agent_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} - gen_ai_invoke_agent_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} offset $__rate_interval) >= 0) or gen_ai_invoke_agent_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"}))

panels.title: LLM call latency (p95)
panels.description: Gemini call latency per service and model (shows the fallback model at work).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name, gen_ai_request_model) (((gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} - gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} offset $__rate_interval) >= 0) or gen_ai_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"}))

panels.title: Token usage by service
panels.description: Input and output tokens per service.

panels.title: Tool execution duration (p95)
panels.description: How long each tool takes: MCP tools (McpTool), A2A agents (AgentTool) and the workout agent's own tool.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_tool_name, gen_ai_agent_name) (((gen_ai_execute_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} - gen_ai_execute_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} offset $__rate_interval) >= 0) or gen_ai_execute_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"}))

panels.title: HTTP requests by service
panels.description: HTTP requests handled by each service, by route.

panels.title: A2A round trip to sub-agents (p95)
panels.description: Time from the orchestrator calling a sub-agent over A2A to getting its answer.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, gen_ai_tool_name) (((gen_ai_execute_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="diet-orchestrator", gen_ai_tool_name=~"grocery_agent|workout_agent"} - gen_ai_execute_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="diet-orchestrator", gen_ai_tool_name=~"grocery_agent|workout_agent"} offset $__rate_interval) >= 0) or gen_ai_execute_tool_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name="diet-orchestrator", gen_ai_tool_name=~"grocery_agent|workout_agent"}))

panels.title: MCP tool calls
panels.description: Calls handled by the MCP server, by tool, in the selected range.

panels.title: Goals requested
panels.description: Calorie targets calculated by the MCP server, by goal (lose / maintain / gain).

panels.title: Exercises suggested
panels.description: Exercises the workout agent priced with its estimate_calories_burned tool.

panels.title: HTTP server latency by service (p95)
panels.description: How long each service takes to answer an HTTP request.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_name) (((http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} - http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"} offset $__rate_interval) >= 0) or http_server_request_duration_seconds_bucket{service_name=~"$service"}))

panels.title: Service graph
panels.description: Built by Tempo from the traces: who calls whom, request rate and latency.

panels.description: Each row is one user request; open it to see the full trace across the orchestrator, MCP server and A2A agents.
